comparison_limits: Three small synthetic fixes and one or two validated successes per task/condition are insufficient for a general ranking.

Vercel uses a manually selected guide; autoskills installs its own recommendations; SkillRadar uses a selected unmodified router bundle rather than native marketplace integration. Installed guidance is not evidence that it was activated.
All 45 planned slots are accounted for, but one eligible slot remains interrupted with unknown attempt state. No overall winner, token savings or price claim is supported.
